warns when calling hooks inside useState.note: A store's initial value is computed by the caller before createStore, outside of render, so there is no initializer for React to run under the nested Hooks dispatcher.

throws after too many iterations.note: 'Too many re-renders' is the useState render phase restart limit. A render phase store.update is scheduled for the next render (COPY_RULES rule 6), so an unconditional one loops across renders. React only stops that loop when enableInfiniteRenderLoopDetection is on (the www variant throws 'Maximum update depth exceeded'). On experimental it never stops, even at sync priority, so the loop outlives the test and the afterEach flush throws a RangeError. That means the analog can't be written as a test that fails cleanly under @gate TODO. Reported to the lead as a finding.

uses reducer passed at time of render, n.note: Swaps the reducer between renders. useReducer uses the reducer from the current render, so it can close over render-time props and state. A store's reducer is fixed when the store is created (it has to be, so updates can be replayed on any root), so there's no store analog of a reducer that closes over render-time values.
